Ko Seung-beom (Korean: 고승범; born 24 April 1994) is a South Korean footballer who plays as midfielder or a winger for K League 2 club Suwon Samsung Bluewings.[3]

Career

[edit]

Ko played college football for Kyunghee University.[4]

Ko joined the K League 1 side Suwon Samsung Bluewings before the 2016 season began.[5]
